lines: 你有没有想过，{{TITLE}} 到底在解决什么问题？
Have you ever wondered what {{TITLE}} is really for?
这一期，我们从一个问题出发，把它拆成可以理解的三步。
This episode starts from one question and splits it into three understandable steps.
先记住一句话：{{ONE_LINE}}
Start with one sentence: {{ONE_LINE_EN}}
这句话有三个关键词。
That sentence has three key words.
第一个关键词是 {{KEY1}}。
The first key word is {{KEY1_EN}}.
第二个关键词是 {{KEY2}}。
The second key word is {{KEY2_EN}}.
第三个关键词是 {{KEY3}}。
The third key word is {{KEY3_EN}}.
把直觉写成公式，只需要三样东西。
Turning the intuition into a formula takes three things.
左边是我们要算的量，右边是已知条件。
The left side is what we compute; the right side is what we know.
中间这个符号，就是把两者联系起来的桥。
The symbol in the middle is the bridge between them.
实际使用时，可以按三步走。
In practice, use three steps.
第一步，先把问题写成可计算的形式。
First, write the problem in a computable form.
第二步，代入已知条件，算出结果。
Second, plug in what you know and compute.
第三步，检查结果是否合理。
Third, check whether the result makes sense.
这一期，我们把 {{TITLE}} 拆成了一句话、一个公式、三个步骤。
This episode reduced {{TITLE}} to one sentence, one formula, and three steps.
